stories.title: Vulnerability management: The cybersecurity industry is still solving the wrong problem
stories.why: We have never been short of vulnerabilities. We have always struggled with remedial work. For decades, the cybersecurity industry has approached vulnerability management from the wrong end.

stories.title: Google spots the first hacker AI system that finds and exploits flaws autonomously
stories.why: Google said it had identified a hacker-operated AI framework designed to discover software vulnerabilities and execute exploits without human intervention, marking the first time its researchers had observed such a…

stories.title: Amazon: China-Linked Hackers’ AI Agents Exploited Medical Software Zero-Day
stories.why: A threat actor used autonomous Cairn AI agents to discover and exploit a critical MONAI Label vulnerability.

stories.title: AI unearths ‘internet breaker’ flaws in Nginx web server
stories.why: Nginx, the web server estimated to power a third of the internet, has shipped fixes for multiple vulnerabilities, including a critical unauthenticated remote code execution flaw that puts millions of websites at risk…

stories.title: China attackers deployed AI agents that autonomously found and exploited a 0-day to take over a university server
stories.why: 'Agents kept adapting for nearly a full day without human direction,' Amazon CISO said

stories.title: Attackers' AI Agents Found a Zero-Day in Medical-Imaging Software and Gained Root Access
stories.why: Suspected China-linked hackers used autonomous AI agents to find a previously unknown flaw in MONAI Label, an open-source medical imaging server, and gain root access to a university server, Amazon Threat Intelligence…

stories.title: SonicWall Warns Gen 6 Firewalls Won't Get Security Patches, Even for Critical Flaws
stories.why: SonicWall has urged all customers still running Generation 6 firewalls to retire and replace them immediately and stop exposing the devices on the internet edge, citing security risks fueled by AI-assisted attacks.

stories.title: Hackers use autonomous AI tool Cairn to find zero-day, take over server
stories.why: Threat actors used the open-source AI penetration-testing framework Cairn to find a previously unknown vulnerability in a medical imaging application.

stories.title: Google and Anthropic push for faster patches as AI collapses bug discovery timelines
stories.why: AI-assisted vulnerability discovery has made it untenable for software vendors to sit on privately reported flaws for months, and Google Project Zero is responding by shrinking its vulnerability disclosure deadline…

stories.title: Amazon says Chinese hackers used Cairn AI tool to discover apparent zero-day during attack on university
stories.why: A China-linked threat actor used the open source AI penetration testing tool Cairn to persistently attack two universities, and in one case, possibly discover a zero-day bug, researchers said.
